text.what: A Livermore landmark at the intersection of the city's four quadrants, trading since 1962.
text.story: Jack and Jean Weil started Jack's Donut Wheel in 1962, the year they moved to Livermore from San Francisco. The name came from a colleague at Stemple's who pointed out that people said Weil as "wheel". The Weils sold in 1972; it has changed hands since and kept the name. The building went up in 1941.
text.today: A small shop that outlasted four sets of owners by not being renamed.

kin.as: Why the name on the window is not the family inside.
The same shape of business, further north.
